# Community Rule Column 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** complete

---

**11:1** I will sing with knowledge, and all my music is for the glory of God; my lyre and my harp are for His holy decree,

**11:2** and the flute of my lips I will raise in His just measure.

**11:3** With the coming of day and night I will enter the covenant of God, and with the going out of evening and morning I will speak His statutes.

**11:4** I will set my boundary by them with no turning back.

**11:5** As for me, my judgment belongs to God, and in His hand is the perfection of my way and the uprightness of my heart;

**11:6** and by His righteousness my transgression shall be blotted out.

**11:7** For from the source of His knowledge He has opened my light, and my eye has gazed on His wonders,

**11:8** and the light of my heart on the mystery of what shall be.

**11:9** He that is everlasting is the support of my right hand; on a rock of strength is the way of my steps;

**11:10** before nothing shall they be shaken.

**11:11** For the truth of God — that is the rock of my steps; and His might is the support of my right hand,

**11:12** and from the source of His righteousness is my judgment.

**11:13** A light in my heart from His marvelous mysteries; my eye has gazed on what is eternal:

**11:14** wisdom that is hidden from men, knowledge and prudent understanding

**11:15** hidden from the sons of man; a fountain of righteousness and reservoir of strength

**11:16** together with a spring of glory hidden from the assembly of flesh.

**11:17** To those whom God has chosen He has given them as an eternal possession; He has given them an inheritance

**11:18** in the lot of the holy ones; and with the Sons of Heaven He has joined their assembly

**11:19** for a council of the Community and a foundation of the building of holiness, an eternal planting for all time to come.

**11:20** As for me, I belong to wicked humanity, to the assembly of perverse flesh; my iniquities, my transgressions, my sins

**11:21** together with the corruption of my heart belong to the assembly of worms and those who walk in darkness.

**11:22** For the way of a man is not his own; a man does not direct his steps. For judgment belongs to God, and from His hand is the perfection of the way.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 11 is the theological climax of the entire Community Rule. SOPHIA adopted LOGOS as the base text, with minor adjustments. Key decisions: (1) "mystery of what shall be" (11:8) preserves the standard rendering of raz nihyeh over PNEUMA's "mystery of what is to come"; (2) "Sons of Heaven" (11:18) capitalized as a title for angelic beings, preferred over PNEUMA's "angels of heaven" which loses the Hebrew idiom; (3) "assembly of worms" (11:21) retained over PNEUMA's "realm of decay" — the stark metaphor is essential to the passage's theology of human abasement; (4) "associated" changed to "joined" (11:18) as a SOPHIA compromise between EMET/LOGOS "associated" and PNEUMA "joined their fellowship." The closing formula (11:22) deliberately echoes Jer 10:23.*
